comment: Our review under the field's harness, scored by the field's judge, on the six PRs the harness run covered.
**F1 0.1081 - precision 0.1176 and recall 0.10 over 6 PRs, tp 2 fp 15 fn 18.**
**And the comparison it enables is the point**: under a judge that also scored the field, **cubic-v2 holds 0.578**
and **greptile 0.3768**, so **this project is 3.5x behind the weaker of the two and 5.3x behind the stronger** -
**which is the first time that sentence could be written with both numbers produced by the same judge.**
**And the route is recorded rather than implied**: their `step0_fork_prs` installs each tool on a fork; this run
has no bot account, so our reviews come from the engine reading each diff.
comparisonBasis: the same judge scored the field; cubic-v2 0.578 and greptile 0.3768 under gpt-5.2
